construction.implementation_origin: Written from scratch in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: schema_version=1, fixture_label, documents[], profile{weights, exclusions{ids,tags,terms}, limit}
shared_schema.document: document_id, fields mapping id/title/description/tags and optional quality to dotted object paths, rows of JSON objects. Unmapped source columns are ignored.
shared_schema.canonical_item: id, title, description: normalized nonempty strings; tags: sorted unique casefolded strings; quality: finite number in [0,1], default 0; source: document_id, zero-based row and field mapping
shared_schema.profile: Casefolded tag weights in [-10,10]; exact case-sensitive normalized ID exclusions; casefolded tag and substring title/description exclusions; integer limit [0,100]
shared_schema.output: status, schema_version, fixture_label, canonical catalog, ranked recommendations with score/explanation/source, excluded with reasons, eligible_count, counts
shared_schema.validation: Shared require/object/text/number/tag validators; canonical items checked at extraction and ranking boundaries. Unknown configuration keys, duplicate item/document IDs, duplicate normalized preferences, duplicate JSON keys and missing mapped fields are errors. Batch is atomic.

cross_stage_handoffs.data: Validated canonical catalog including normalized tags, quality and original document/row/field provenance
cross_stage_handoffs.enforcement: Ranking revalidates each item; it never reads raw document rows.

behavior.extraction: Configurable nested object extraction, whitespace cleanup, comma-separated or array tags, deduplication and bounded numeric validation
behavior.ranking: Exclude first, then descending quality plus sum of matching signed tag weights; exact score ties sort by ID; apply limit last. Empty interests fall back to quality.
behavior.explanations: Structured matched tags and signed contributions, base quality, formula and provenance; exclusions include the matched rule and source text field where applicable
behavior.errors: CLI prints one JSON object with status error and exits 2 for validation or file errors; success exits 0.
behavior.fixtures: All example records and preferences are explicitly synthetic
behavior.determinism: No randomness, current-time dependencies, learned model or external provider
